name: Giant Mole

mechanics.name: Claws
mechanics.description: Her only attack. She swipes with her claws at close range and has nothing that reaches further.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Melee. She cannot touch you from a distance, so a safespot ends the fight for her.

mechanics.name: Burrow
mechanics.description: She digs into the ground and comes up somewhere else in the tunnels, leaving you to find her again.
mechanics.counterplay: Learn the handful of spots she surfaces in, or bring a mole locator. Chasing her blind costs more time than the kill.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids 5779 and 6499, the second a copy carrying the identical model set and animations. Animations are the MOLE_* set, all unambiguous gameval names: ATTACK 3312, BURROW_DOWN 3314 and BURROW_UP 3315. Both burrow sequences are curated as triggers on the same mechanic, since going down and coming up are one move. No projectile is curated: the four MOLE_MUD_* spotanims (570 through 573) are the mud thrown up by the burrow and are all named SPOTANIM, so none meets this wave's bar of an unambiguous projectile name; a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (docs/DECISIONS.md D17) and discovery never revokes (D18). TWO MECHANICS IS AN HONEST COUNT FOR THIS BOSS, not a shortfall: she has one attack and one movement trick, and the wiki's strategy page is mostly about finding her again afterwards. THE BURROW PREVIEW HAS A NEGATIVE shiftY, WHICH IS CORRECT AND NOT A MISTAKE. It is the only preview in this wave to need one: the burrow animation carries the model below the ground plane, so the correction that centres its envelope pushes down rather than up. The claw preview needed the opposite treatment, a zoom raise, because at that animation the model sits entirely above the ground line and its centring offset projected past the 70px ceiling BundledBossDataTest enforces. staticFallback is false on both; whether either body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Giant Mole', matching 'name'.
